comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body: I found that when assembling SWMPs and you complete a map, the game will try, though not always, to pop up a shipwreck close to your current location. So if your in Europe and you finish a map there you have a greater chance of getting a SW there then other places. You can still get a SW halfway across the world of course. Maybe try assembling the map in East Asia next time?

comments.body:
I used Letters of Appreciation to get East Asia ★6 higher map for a legacy clue.
I got ★7 map and found this map is "East Asia Trade Ship". pulled it right below Sakai. Found Meiping!!

It is known that Meiping can be discovered only from ★7 "East Asia Trade Ship" (not "East Asia Tow Boat")

Anyway, I got this using LoA not SWMP :)
